name: xTool F1
notes: Galvo laser. Blue 455 nm, infrared 1064 nm.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension MF1 (exts/F1), read 2026-11-26.
